label: HTTP

payload_bytes.label: Payload
payload_bytes.description: Actual NIS application chunk octets; whole HTTP content/message/framing differ. No8-byte or65535-byte protocol default.
payload_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

http_version.label: version
http_version.description: Actual protocol version, unknown. Different text/binary/QUIC framing and flow control; no latest-version default.
http_version.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_transport.label: transport
http_transport.description: Actual selected transport, unknown. HTTP2TCP and HTTP3QUIC differ; HTTP1 custom reliable transport needs matched implementation source.
http_transport.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_binding_source.label: binding source
http_binding_source.description: Required actual registered TCP/TLS or QUIC/IP/physical path and peer endpoints, unknown; no automatic Ethernet100M or TCP mapping for all versions.
http_binding_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_implementation_source.label: implementation source
http_implementation_source.description: Required actual client/server/proxy version, supported negotiated protocol and resource limits, unknown.
http_implementation_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_schedule_source.label: schedule source
http_schedule_source.description: Required actual handshake/application/flow-control/transport recovery/concurrency schedule evidence, unknown; HTTP defines no universal deadline.
http_schedule_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_role.label: role
http_role.description: Actual endpoint role, unknown. Response, push and settings direction depend on role; proxy requires each actual leg.
http_role.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_message_kind.label: message kind
http_message_kind.description: Actual message direction; method/status/body semantics differ.
http_message_kind.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_scheme.label: scheme
http_scheme.description: Actual origin scheme, unknown. Default ports80/443 are proposals only when origin has no explicit port, not all endpoints.
http_scheme.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_port_explicit.label: port explicit
http_port_explicit.description: Whether actual origin contains explicit port, unknown; false permits scheme-default proposal, never overwrites explicit13500 etc.
http_port_explicit.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_port.label: port
http_port.description: Actual endpoint port, unknown; scheme-default80/443 proposal only when port elided.
http_port.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_origin.label: origin
http_origin.description: Actual http(s) origin/resource URI, unknown; nonempty host, no embedded credentials or fragment. Request-target forms are separate.
http_origin.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_method.label: method
http_method.description: Actual case-sensitive method token, unknown; extension tokens allowed, no universal GET command.
http_method.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_status.label: status
http_status.description: Actual response status100..599; unknown/reserved3-digit statuses retain class semantics. Not mandatory for requests.
http_status.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_target_form.label: target form
http_target_form.description: Actual HTTP1 request-target form. CONNECT authority, OPTIONS asterisk and proxy absolute target differ from HTTP2/3 pseudoheaders.
http_target_form.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_target_source.label: target source
http_target_source.description: Actual URI/Host/:authority/:scheme/:path and target normalization/route evidence, unknown; no automatic URL constructed from device name.
http_target_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_tls_version.label: tls version
http_tls_version.description: Actual negotiated security version, unknown. HTTP3 QUICv1 TLS1.3; HTTP2TLS at least1.2; actual certificate/ALPN acceptance separate.
http_tls_version.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_security_source.label: security source
http_security_source.description: Actual negotiated TLS/QUIC certificate/origin authentication/ALPN/cipher/0RTT policy evidence, unknown.
http_security_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_framing.label: framing
http_framing.description: Actual selected message framing. HTTP1 chunk/close differ from HTTP2/3 stream framing; successful CONNECT becomes tunnel.
http_framing.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_transfer_encoding.label: transfer encoding
http_transfer_encoding.description: Actual HTTP1 Transfer-Encoding final coding; not content compression. HTTP2/3 forbid Transfer-Encoding, though TE:trailers differs.
http_transfer_encoding.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_transfer_source.label: transfer source
http_transfer_source.description: Actual transfer coding chain/chunk extensions/final terminator/trailers source, unknown; raw byte parsing not proven by counters.
http_transfer_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_content_length_present.label: content length present
http_content_length_present.description: Actual presence of Content-Length, unknown. Sender must not combine with Transfer-Encoding; HEAD/304 may report selected-representation length.
http_content_length_present.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_content_length.label: content length
http_content_length.description: Actual nonnegative decimal Content-Length with no protocol-wide upper bound; text preserves arbitrary exact digits without JS precision loss.
http_content_length.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_length_semantics.label: length semantics
http_length_semantics.description: Actual Content-Length semantic target, unknown; HEAD/304 metadata can differ from transmitted empty content.
http_length_semantics.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_body_bytes.label: body bytes
http_body_bytes.description: Actual transmitted content octets as exact decimal text. No65535 maximum or8-byte default; excludes chunk framing and HTTP2 padding.
http_body_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_wire_message_bytes.label: wire message bytes
http_wire_message_bytes.description: Actual whole encoded HTTP message/stream octets as exact decimal text, unknown. Compression/headers/chunks/frame boundaries are not inferred from content.
http_wire_message_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_encoding_source.label: encoding source
http_encoding_source.description: Actual encoded content/header/trailer/chunk/HPACK/QPACK representation and whole message evidence, unknown.
http_encoding_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_acceptance_source.label: acceptance source
http_acceptance_source.description: Actual application acceptance/units/idempotence/retries/cache/proxy/response correlation evidence, unknown; transport delivery is not functional acceptance.
http_acceptance_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_request_timeout_ms.label: request timeout ms
http_request_timeout_ms.description: Actual implementation/application request deadline, unknown; no universal HTTP100/500ms standard.
http_request_timeout_ms.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_retry_limit.label: retry limit
http_retry_limit.description: Actual application retry policy and idempotence/source evidence, unknown; HTTP retries differ from TCP/QUIC retransmission.
http_retry_limit.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_retry_source.label: retry source
http_retry_source.description: Actual method idempotence/replay/partial-processing and retry acceptance evidence, unknown. A lost response does not prove request was not applied.
http_retry_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_transition_optimistic.label: transition optimistic
http_transition_optimistic.description: Actual optimistic HTTP1 Upgrade/CONNECT behavior, unknown; RFC9931 requires explicit safety relative to possible HTTP misinterpretation.
http_transition_optimistic.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_transition_source.label: transition source
http_transition_source.description: Actual negotiated transition/confirmation and harmless-prefix/smuggling risk evidence per RFC9931, unknown; tunnel is not auto-safe.
http_transition_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_frame_type.label: http2 frame type
http2_frame_type.description: Actual HTTP2 frame type, unknown; fixed-type payloads and stream scope differ.
http2_frame_type.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_stream_id.label: http2 stream id
http2_stream_id.description: Actual31-bit HTTP2 stream ID; DATA/HEADERS on nonzero streams; connection frames stream0. No defaultassigned stream1.
http2_stream_id.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_frame_header_bytes.label: http2 frame header bytes
http2_frame_header_bytes.description: HTTP2 fixed9-octet header proposal only for actual HTTP2. Excluded from SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE.
http2_frame_header_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_frame_payload_bytes.label: http2 frame payload bytes
http2_frame_payload_bytes.description: Actual24-bit HTTP2 frame payload, incl padding/pad length if used; at most actual receiver-advertised max, distinct from content/message.
http2_frame_payload_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_frame_bytes.label: http2 frame bytes
http2_frame_bytes.description: Actual HTTP2 frame9+payload octets; not TCP segment or Ethernet frame length.
http2_frame_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_settings_phase.label: http2 settings phase
http2_settings_phase.description: Actual settings state. Normative initial values can be proposed only before peer values are supplied; never overwrite peer advertisements.
http2_settings_phase.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_max_frame_size.label: http2 max frame size
http2_max_frame_size.description: Actual peer SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE range16384..16777215; initial16384 proposal. Not message-body maximum.
http2_max_frame_size.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_header_table_size.label: http2 header table size
http2_header_table_size.description: Actual HPACK SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE uint32, initial4096 proposal; negotiated decoder context differs from uncompressed field size.
http2_header_table_size.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_initial_window_size.label: http2 initial window size
http2_initial_window_size.description: Actual SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE stream limit, initial65535 proposal; current stream/connection windows change independently.
http2_initial_window_size.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_current_stream_window.label: http2 current stream window
http2_current_stream_window.description: Actual remaining stream flow-control window. Can be negative after SETTINGS decrease; negative window permits no DATA, no unsigned fallback.
http2_current_stream_window.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_current_connection_window.label: http2 current connection window
http2_current_connection_window.description: Actual remaining connection DATA window; initial65535, WINDOW_UPDATE changes it. Not changed by stream SETTINGS.
http2_current_connection_window.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_enable_push.label: http2 enable push
http2_enable_push.description: Actual SETTINGS_ENABLE_PUSH0/1; initialclient1, serverinitial value has no effect equivalent0. Actual support/state required.
http2_enable_push.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_max_concurrent_streams.label: http2 max concurrent streams
http2_max_concurrent_streams.description: Actual advertised uint32 limit, initially unlimited if absent; no fabricated100/256-stream maximum.
http2_max_concurrent_streams.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_max_header_list_bytes.label: http2 max header list bytes
http2_max_header_list_bytes.description: Actual advisory uncompressed field-list limit incl32bytes per field; initially unlimited if absent, not a zero-byte default.
http2_max_header_list_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_pad_length_present.label: http2 pad length present
http2_pad_length_present.description: Actual PADDED flag and one-byte PadLength presence for DATA/HEADERS/PUSH_PROMISE, unknown.
http2_pad_length_present.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_padding_bytes.label: http2 padding bytes
http2_padding_bytes.description: Actual padding octets0..255 when PADDED, excluding1-byte PadLength; all are part of frame payload and DATA flow-control cost.
http2_padding_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http2_data_bytes.label: http2 data bytes
http2_data_bytes.description: Actual content inside DATA frame excluding padding/PadLength; distinct from complete message content and receiver window cost.
http2_data_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_frame_type.label: http3 frame type
http3_frame_type.description: Actual QUIC-varint HTTP3 frame type0..2^62-1 as exact decimal text. Separate registry from HTTP2.
http3_frame_type.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_frame_length.label: http3 frame length
http3_frame_length.description: Actual QUIC-varint HTTP3 frame payload length0..2^62-1 as exact decimal text; no9-byte header or16384 maximum inherited from HTTP2.
http3_frame_length.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_stream_kind.label: http3 stream kind
http3_stream_kind.description: Actual QUIC stream kind: DATA/HEADERS request or push; SETTINGS control. QPACK streams are independent byte streams.
http3_stream_kind.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_qpack_max_table.label: http3 qpack max table
http3_qpack_max_table.description: Actual SETTINGS_QPACK_MAX_TABLE_CAPACITY uint62 as exact decimal text, initial0; not HTTP2 HPACK4096 default.
http3_qpack_max_table.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_qpack_blocked_streams.label: http3 qpack blocked streams
http3_qpack_blocked_streams.description: Actual SETTINGS_QPACK_BLOCKED_STREAMS uint62 as exact decimal text, initial0; blocking/recovery remains actual QUIC/QPACK schedule.
http3_qpack_blocked_streams.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_max_field_section_bytes.label: http3 max field section bytes
http3_max_field_section_bytes.description: Actual advertised uint62 maximum field-section size as exact decimal text; absent means unlimited, not0 or HTTP2 frame-size limit.
http3_max_field_section_bytes.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_settings_phase.label: http3 settings phase
http3_settings_phase.description: Actual HTTP3 settings state.1RTT initial defaults differ from remembered0RTT peer values; do not overwrite remembered settings.
http3_settings_phase.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http3_quic_source.label: http3 quic source
http3_quic_source.description: Actual QUIC version, varint widths, stream limits, flow control, recovery and congestion/pacing source, unknown; no assumed TCP schedule.
http3_quic_source.source_revision: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling

http_transition_token.label: transition token
http_transition_token.description: Actual upgrade/CONNECT protocol, unknown. RFC9931 distinguishes TLS, WebSocket, UDP/IP tunneling and untrusted TCP CONNECT; source alone does not override prohibited optimistic sending.

http_connect_untrusted.label: connect untrusted
http_connect_untrusted.description: Actual CONNECT forwarding on behalf of untrusted TCP client, unknown. Do not assume trusted false; wait-success or Connection:close required for HTTP1.

http_wait_success.label: wait success
http_wait_success.description: Actual proxy waits for successful2xx before forwarding TCP payload, unknown. Distinct from application deadline and declared source text.

http_connection_close.label: connection close
http_connection_close.description: Actual Connection:close request/rejection connection behavior. HTTP1 untrusted CONNECT requires close or wait; rejecting proxy must close underlying connection under RFC9931.

http_transition_rejected.label: transition rejected
http_transition_rejected.description: Actual CONNECT transition rejection state, unknown. Underlying connection must be closed by HTTP1 rejecting proxy without processing further requests.
